newsitem.title: USA: GPU 610 MW N.J. power unit in startup mode.
newsitem.headline: GPU 610 MW N.J. power unit in startup mode.

text.p: GPU Nuclear's 610 megawatt Oyster Creek nuclear power plant in Forked River, N.J., began startup early Wednesday, returning from a repair outage that began Oct 25, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The plant was "in startup, but not yet critical," the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Company spokeswoman Susan Mysak confirmed the startup, adding "the plant should be on line generating electricity sometime around midnight (EST) tonight."
The unit ws shut due to fluctuating levels of generator cooling water.
GPU Nuclear is a subsidiary of GPU Inc.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
